strings.subtitle: — Mosenyi wa faele —
strings.no_file: Ga go na faele e e tlhophilweng
strings.dnd_unavailable: Go goga le go tlogela ga go a bonega. Dirisa konopo e e kwa tlase.
strings.ft_lnk: Tsela e khutshwane (.lnk) — e tla ganelwa
strings.strategy_full: ☢  O TLALETSENG — tsotlhe ka lefela (e bolokesegile)
strings.ssd_warning:
Temoso! Mo SSD, mokgwa wa go kwala godimo ga o netefatse go senyega ka ntlha ya TRIM.
Lenaneo leno ke la HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Faele "{name}" e tla kwalwa godimo mme e phimolwe.

Tswelela?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.error_cannot_read:
Ga e kgone go buisa faele:
{err}
strings.report_title: ✅  FAELE E KWADILWE GODIMO E PHIMOLWA
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS mela ya data e mengwe (ADS) ga e dirisiwe.
• Lokwalodikgang lwa USN ga lo phepafadiwe.
• Dikhopi tsa moriti le dikgolagano tsa leru
  (OneDrive jj.) ga di amege.
strings.step_delete: Go phimola go feta moqomo wa matlakala
strings.status_full: Diteng di kwadilwe godimo ka botlalo ka lefela. Go busa ga go kgonege — didirisiwa di tla bona lefela fela.
strings.status_fast: Tlhogo, moswele le mela ya 4 MB di kwadilwe godimo. Tse dingwe ga di a amega, mme ka ntlha ya dikgala, go busa ka botlalo ka didirisiwa tsa moreki ga go kgonege. Mo dikwalong tsa sephiri, dirisa MOKGWA O O TLALETSENG.
strings.status_empty: Faele e ne e le lefela, go kwala godimo ga go a tlhokege. E phimotswe.
strings.error_permission: Ga e kgone go fitlhelela faele. E kanna e bulwa mo lenaneong lengwe. E tswale mme o leke gape.
strings.error_not_found: Faele ga e a bonwa. E kanna e phimotswe.
strings.error_is_symlink: Eno ke kgolagano ya letshwao. Dikgolagano ga di kgone go senyega — faele ya maikaelelo e tla nna e siame.
strings.error_reparse: Eno ke faele ya lefelo (OneDrive kgotsa e e tshwanang). Data ya yone e mo lerung, eseng mo disk — ga go sepe se se senyegang fano.
strings.error_not_file: Eno ga se faele (foltara kgotsa sengwe). Tlogela faele.
strings.error_hardlinks: Faele eno e na le dikgolagano tse dingwe tse di thata ({n} tsotlhe). Dikgolagano tse di thata ga di na kgolo — maina otlhe a a lekana. Fa o senya ka tsela ya jaanong, data e tla kwalwa godimo mme e segiwe go 32 byte, mme masalela a tla nna a fitlhelega ka dikgolagano tse dingwe. Phimola dikgolagano tsotlhe pele.
strings.error_compressed:
Faele e gateletswe, e khupilwe kgotsa e sesa. Go kwala godimo ka lefela ga go netefatse go senyega ga data ya kgale ka gonne NTFS e e boloka ka tsela e e farologaneng.

Tlosa tshobokanyo: tobetsa ka moja → Ditlhopho → Tse di kwa godimo → tlosa letshwao mo go "Gatelela" le/kgotsa "Khupa". Morago o kitla o diragatsa SHREDDER gape.
